sounddevice_missing: Recording on this system needs the Python package sounddevice (PortAudio). Install it with pip install sounddevice, or install vinyl-check with the extra [portaudio].
portaudio_missing: The PortAudio library could not be loaded ({error}). On Linux install the package libportaudio2, or record with arecord (audio_backend = "alsa").
device_not_found: Recording device “{device}” not found. Is it connected and switched on? Choose the device under Settings → Audio interface or in the turntable profile.
hostapi_resamples: “{device}” goes through the Windows mixer, which resamples. Choose the WASAPI or ASIO entry of the same device.
channels_unsupported: “{device}”: {channels} input channels are needed, the device offers {max}. Choose other inputs or another device under Settings → Audio interface.
rate_unsupported: “{device}” cannot record at {rate} Hz without resampling (device default: {default_rate} Hz). {hint}
hint_rate: Switch the interface to this rate, or choose a rate it supports under Settings → Audio interface (usually 44100 or 48000).
hint_rate_wasapi: In shared mode Windows records in the format set under Sound settings → the device → Properties → Advanced. Set it to this rate, or allow exclusive mode there and turn on WASAPI exclusive mode under Settings → Audio interface.
format_unsupported: “{device}” cannot deliver {format} directly. Choose another bit depth under Settings → Audio interface (16, 24 or 32 bit).
format_unknown: Unknown sample_format {format}: use S16_LE, S24_3LE or S32_LE.
device_busy: “{device}” is in use by another program with exclusive access. Close that program and try again.
exclusive_unavailable: WASAPI exclusive mode is not available ({error}). Recording in shared mode through the Windows mixer: check its format and turn off audio enhancements for this device.
device_stalled: “{device}” has delivered no audio for {s} seconds, the recording was ended. Is the device still connected?
digital_silence: The device delivers only digital silence. Check the selected input, the input level in the system settings and the cables.
digital_silence_mac: The device delivers only digital silence. On macOS allow microphone access for vinyl-check (or the terminal it runs in) under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, then restart it.
